title: Once Upon A Tide I Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Attached to the Once Upon A Tide main house is this private apartment lock-off that accommodates four, ‘Once Upon A Tide I.’
description_expanded: 142 SEASIDE AVENUE*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.Once Upon a Tide 1 | Prime Seaside Avenue LocationOnce Upon a Tide 1 is a spacious one-bedroom lock-off ideally located on iconic Seaside Avenue, just one block from the town center and a short stroll to Seaside’s sugar-white beaches. This charming coastal retreat offers both privacy and convenience, making it an excellent choice for couples or small families seeking a walkable Seaside vacation rental.Outdoor Living & Private PorchGuests enter through a private side entrance that opens onto a large, welcoming front porch overlooking a peaceful, landscaped yard framed by classic white picket fencing. Furnished with an outdoor dining table that seats eight, this open-air porch is perfect for al fresco meals, morning coffee, or evening cocktails while enjoying the quiet surroundings and coastal breeze.Open Living, Dining & Kitchen AreaInside, the home features an open and inviting living space with a mounted flat-screen TV, seamlessly connected to the dining and kitchen areas. The dining table comfortably seats four, while the kitchen breakfast bar provides additional seating for four more. The full-size kitchen is well equipped with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and cookware—ideal for both short stays and extended Seaside getaways.King Loft Bedroom & Private BalconyUpstairs, the king primary loft bedroom offers a serene retreat complete with a full bathroom featuring a tub and shower combination. Just off the loft, a spacious private open-air balcony provides seating for two and overlooks the treetops, landscaped yard, brick-paved Seaside streets, and charming white picket fences. This tranquil space is perfect for reading, relaxing, or enjoying a quiet afternoon escape.Once Upon a Tide 1 is a much larger one-bedroom lock-off escape for couples located on a quiet corner of Seaside Avenue and Savannah Street. Need a little more space? Be sure and check out the additional two-bedroom lock-off option, Once Upon a Tide 2.(Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance. HVAC thermostat is locked to not allow air conditioning temperature to be set below 68.)* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion4-minute walk to beach access, approximately 352 yardsWasher & DryerNetflix accessPeacock Alley Linens, featuring fresh and luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking information, one parking pass is issued for this one-bedroom cottage. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002215
